rule: In a free-for-all multiplayer match of several games, if the previous game was won by one player and no player left it because the game was a draw for them, the losers of that game are the players who left it by losing, each at the moment they lost, and any players still in the game when the winner won, at the moment the game ended. If there is more than one loser, the player who lost first is the loser who chooses who takes the first turn. If several players lost first at the same moment, those players decide among themselves which of them chooses, and if they cannot agree the chooser is picked at random from them. If the previous game was a draw, or was a draw for any player, the draw sentence of 103.1 applies and this rule does not apply. The rule does not apply to team games, or to any game type whose starting player the Comprehensive Rules already settle by their own rule, such as Archenemy games (103.1b) and Supervillain Rumble (904.12c); those stay as they are.
